mapper.select: select , , ua.id as purchaser_user_id, ua.display_name as purchaser_name, ua.phone as purchaser_phone from booking_order bo join admission_session s on s.id = bo.session_id join venue v on v.id = s.venue_id join user_account ua on ua.id = bo.user_id where bo.id = #{orderId} and s.venue_id = #{venueId}

select item.id as order_item_id, item.visitor_id, item.visitor_name, item.visitor_id_type, item.visitor_id_number, item.session_ticket_type_id, item.ticket_type_name, item.unit_price, t.id as ticket_id, t.ticket_code, t.status as ticket_status, t.valid_from, t.valid_until, t.verified_at from booking_order_item item left join ticket t on t.order_item_id = item.id where item.order_id = #{orderId} order by item.id

mapper.update: update booking_order bo join admission_session s on s.id = bo.session_id set bo.status = 'COMPLETED', bo.completed_at = #{now}, bo.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where bo.status = 'PAID' and s.status = 'ENDED'
mapper.insert: insert into booking_order (order_no, user_id, session_id, quantity, user_coupon_id, original_amount, discount_amount, total_amount, status, payment_no, expire_at, paid_at, cancelled_at, closed_at, completed_at, refund_at) values (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{quantity}, #{userCouponId}, #{originalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{paymentNo}, #{expireAt}, #{paidAt}, #{cancelledAt}, #{closedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{refundAt})
